Change monthly_trend component date_column parameter from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to align the trend with when care began rather than when claims were processed, eliminating date lag artifacts.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When calculating denial rates for claims analysis, use adjudicated claims (status in Paid, Denied, Adjusted) as the denominator to exclude pending claims which have not yet been decided. Record and state this denominator choice explicitly in reporting to ensure statistical discipline and rate accuracy across all claim analysis work.

For monthly claim volume and financial trends, key the analysis on service_date_from (when care was delivered) rather than adjudication_date (when the claim was processed), as adjudication dates lag service delivery and can distort temporal patterns.
